lines.en: Rumble through the earth with a deep growl
Massive body moves slowly
Radiates an ancient presence

lines.zh: 低垂着巨大的脑袋前行
lines.en: Carries its huge head low
Swings its sharp claws
Issues a warning growl
Scans its surroundings
Occasionally spits a flame

lines.zh: 步伐沉重，如同远古的巨兽
lines.en: Steps heavily, like an ancient beast
Slowly turns its head
Stands silently
Stares into the distance

lines.zh: 缓缓移动着巨大的身体
lines.en: Moves its massive body slowly
Seems to be pondering
Occasionally looks down
Makes a low hiss
Stands quietly, waiting
Sharp eyes scanning around
Slowly twists its body
Occasionally stretches

lines.zh: 它胸口的裂缝缓缓开合
lines.en: The fissure in its chest opens and closes
The bell's echo still clings to it

lines.zh: 巨大的影子盖住半片林地
lines.en: Its shadow covers half the woodland
It presses one finger to the ground
Its breath comes out with stone dust

lines.zh: 古老的语言在它喉中滚动
lines.en: An ancient tongue rolls in its throat
Locks eyes on you
Alertly observes you
Fills with hostility
Notices you, growls lowly
Eyes turn to your position

lines.zh: 钟声还在响，我的眼睛没离开。
lines.en: The bell is still ringing, and my eyes have not left you.
Approaches you slowly after noticing
Fixes you in its gaze, ready to devour
Bears a threat in its gaze
Scans you, assessing
It lowers its head and knows you
That gaze is heavier than the bell
The twisted form trembles.
Ancient power fades.
Energy within stirs chaotically.

lines.zh: 皮肤下流动着奇异的光芒。
lines.en: Strange light flows beneath the skin.
Pain warps my will.

lines.zh: 力量开始从我体内流失。
lines.en: Power drains from me.
My form begins to crumble.
I feel increasingly weak.

lines.zh: 古老的力量支撑不住了。
lines.en: Ancient power fades.

lines.zh: 这具古旧的躯壳也会痛
lines.en: Even this ancient shell can feel pain

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒，令我饥渴。
lines.en: Your light feeds my hunger.

lines.zh: 我的力量来自星辰与深渊。
lines.en: My strength comes from stars and depths.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒，我渴望一尝。
lines.en: The light on you, I long to try.

lines.zh: 你靠近我，便与我的力量共鸣。
lines.en: You come near, and resonate with my power.

lines.zh: 光明中潜藏杀机，你察觉了吗？
lines.en: Danger lies in the light, have you noticed?
Light is your lure to be devoured.

lines.zh: 我的存在是为了打破光明。
lines.en: My existence is to break the light.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的养分，你亦如此。
lines.en: Darkness feeds me, so do you.

lines.zh: 光明中的秘密，我已洞悉。
lines.en: The secrets in the light, I have seen.

lines.zh: 光明无法满足我，黑暗才是永恒。
lines.en: Light cannot satisfy me, darkness is eternal.

lines.zh: 你的力量无法伤我分毫。
lines.en: Your strength cannot harm me.

lines.zh: 碰撞只会加速你的毁灭。
lines.en: Collision accelerates your demise.
Your attacks are ineffective.

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，只会加速消散。
lines.en: Colliding with me hastens your fading.

lines.zh: 我的存在不惧任何碰撞。
lines.en: I am unafraid of any collision.
You cannot touch my true form.

lines.zh: 我的力量超越了物质界限。
lines.en: My power transcends the material.

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，只会徒增痛苦。
lines.en: Colliding with me only adds to your pain.
My essence is hard to touch.

lines.zh: 你与我碰撞，只会加速灭亡。
lines.en: Colliding with me only hastens your end.
I never communicate with my kind.
Dialogues with my kind are meaningless.
I do not need a partner, I am eternal alone.
My existence transcends reproduction.
I never desire my kind.
I am alone and need no mate.

lines.zh: 我的同类从不相互吸引。
lines.en: My kind are never attracted to each other.
I do not share with my kind.

lines.zh: 我与同类之间没有联系。
lines.en: There is no connection between my kind.
My power cannot be replicated.

lines.zh: 我感觉到你的力量，小小凡人。
lines.en: I feel your strength, puny mortal.
You cannot defeat me.
This will be your final battle.
Why do you challenge the ancient god?
Your fate is sealed.
Taste the sweetness of death.
My power far exceeds your imagination.
You cannot comprehend my existence.

lines.zh: 你只是我漫长岁月中的一个小插曲。
lines.en: You are but a small interlude in my long existence.
Your courage pleases me.
You finally show yourself, mortal.

lines.zh: 钟声把我唤来，你就在钟下。
lines.en: The bell summoned me, and you stand beneath it.
Prepare to meet thy fate.

lines.zh: 钟声把我叫来，你就别想走。
lines.en: The bell called me; you will not leave.

lines.zh: 我数着你头顶的高度，准备抛。
lines.en: I am measuring the height above you before the throw.
You cannot evade my gaze.

lines.zh: 钟声招来的我，不会空手回去。
lines.en: The bell called me. I do not leave empty-handed.
You will bear witness to my existence.

lines.zh: 你的死亡只是时间问题。
lines.en: Your death is only a matter of time.

lines.zh: 你将成为传说的一部分。
lines.en: You will be part of the legend.
The bell pointed you out to it

lines.zh: 它抬起手，虚握你的方向
lines.en: It lifts a hand and closes on your direction
You have stepped into its ground

lines.zh: 远古的注意力落到了你身上
lines.en: Ancient attention settles on you
It has memorized your heartbeat

lines.zh: 它终于找到了要碾碎的东西
lines.en: At last it found something to crush
It takes its first step toward you

lines.zh: 巨影动了，朝你这个方向
lines.en: The giant shadow moves, toward you
I will enjoy your struggle.
Feel my will.
My shadow will envelop you.
I will crush you.

lines.zh: 你是唯一能威胁我的存在。
lines.en: You are the only one who can threaten my existence.

lines.zh: 你的攻击对我毫无作用。
lines.en: Your attacks are useless against me.
You can only watch me.
Feel the end coming.
My existence is eternal.

lines.zh: 我会把你抛到云上面去。
lines.en: I will throw you above the clouds.
It is calculating how high to throw you

lines.zh: 它的手臂已经抬到半空
lines.en: Its arm is already raised halfway
When the bell stops, it strikes
It waits for you to come a little closer
It watches where you will land
That hand hangs over your head

lines.zh: 它在挑一个摔死你的角度
lines.en: It picks the angle that kills you on landing

lines.zh: 古老的杀意慢慢压下来
lines.en: Ancient killing intent presses slowly down
It stops watching you and watches the ground
It prepares to throw you into the clouds

lines.zh: 它张开巨口，露出了锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: It opens its massive mouth, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始发光，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its body glows, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 它挥动巨大的手臂，试图抓向你。
lines.en: It swings its massive arms, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛放出寒光，怒视着你。
lines.en: Its eyes emit cold light, glaring at you with anger.

lines.zh: 你被它抛向高空，感受到它的力量。
lines.en: You are thrown high into the air, feeling its power.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕在你身上，试图将你拖走。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, trying to drag you away.

lines.zh: 它伸出长长的舌头，试图舔食你。
lines.en: It extends its long tongue, trying to lick you.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴拍击地面，释放出能量。
lines.en: It slaps the ground with its tail, releasing energy.
You dodge too late, being hit by it.

lines.zh: 它用力一挥，你被远远击飞。
lines.en: It swings powerfully, sending you flying far.
One hand hurls you into the sky
Its claw sweeps through and the trees snap
Its fist falls and the ground splits

lines.zh: 你的护甲在它掌下变形
lines.en: Your armor buckles under its palm

lines.zh: 神秘之钟的声音回荡在整个区域。
lines.en: The mysterious clock’s sound echoes throughout the area.

lines.zh: 一道光芒从神秘之钟中射出。
lines.en: A beam of light shoots out from the mysterious clock.

lines.zh: 光芒中显现出一个巨大身影。
lines.en: A giant figure appears in the light.

lines.zh: 古钟的钟声催促着远古实体现身。
lines.en: The clock’s chime summons the Ancient Entity.

lines.zh: 它从神秘之钟中缓缓走出。
lines.en: It slowly emerges from the mysterious clock.

lines.zh: 远古实体开始在周围游荡。
lines.en: The Ancient Entity starts to wander around.

lines.zh: 你看到地面上突然出现一个黑洞。
lines.en: You see a black hole appear on the ground suddenly.

lines.zh: 一个巨大的身影从黑洞中走出。
lines.en: A giant figure emerges from the black hole.

lines.zh: 你意识到这是远古实体的出现。
lines.en: You realize it’s the appearance of the Ancient Entity.

lines.zh: 远古实体凝视着主世界。
lines.en: The Ancient Entity gazes at the Overworld.
The mysterious bell has been struck
The bell tolls a rift open
A patch of ground goes black first

lines.zh: 一只手从裂口里伸出来
lines.en: A hand reaches out of the rift

lines.zh: 它踩着钟声走进主世界
lines.en: It walks into the overworld on the bell's note

lines.zh: 八百点的古神站直了身子
lines.en: The eight-hundred-point god stands tall
The giant shadow blots out the moonlight
The void still drips from the rift's edge

lines.zh: 它环视这片陌生的林地
lines.en: It looks around this unfamiliar woodland

lines.zh: 古钟的余响化成了脚步声
lines.en: The bell's echo becomes footsteps
Flames scorch my skin.

lines.zh: 跌落的冲击撕裂我的身体。
lines.en: Impact of fall tears my body.
Sea water corrodes my scales.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕裂我的虚空之躯。
lines.en: Explosion rips through my form.
Arrow pierces my body.

lines.zh: 魔法之力撕裂我的护盾。
lines.en: Magic tears my shield.
Hunger eats at my will.
Lightning strikes my form.
Void devours my being.
